build_masked_mmimdb_dataset: build a masked multimodal IMDB dataset builder registered under the name masked_mmimdb in MMF
create_masked_mmimdb_builder: create a MaskedMMImdbBuilder instance that extends VQA2Builder with masked_mmimdb as the dataset name
review_config_path: review the MaskedMMImdbBuilder config_path method that returns configs/datasets/mmimdb/masked.yaml
test_masked_mmimdb_registration: test that MaskedMMImdbBuilder is registered in the MMF registry under the key masked_mmimdb
refactor_masked_mmimdb_dataset_class: refactor the MaskedMMImdbBuilder to use a different dataset class instead of MaskedMMImdbDataset
